main.description: A link to an external profile or website - can be a social network profile, academic profile, or custom web link. Limits per profile: 1 per social platform, max 3 custom web links

type.description: Type of link - social (Twitter, LinkedIn), academic (ORCID, Scholar), or web (custom links)

platform.description: Platform identifier for social/academic links (use 'custom' for web type)

url.description: Full URL to the profile or website

title.description: Display title for the link (primarily for custom web links)

username.description: Username or identifier on the platform (for social/academic links)

isLocked.description: Whether this link can be edited/deleted (Bluesky profile is locked, derived from auth)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this link was created
